items.title: See What Changed: AI & Semantic Models in Tabular Editor | Ruben Van de Voorde
items.summary: The art of developing semantic models is in flux, and so are the tools you wield. When AI agents are moving on your model, you need a clear view on what was changed and how it fits into the bigger picture of your model. In this session, we'll show you how that's done in Tabular Editor 3. We'll show you how to: \- Connect an agent you already use\, such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot\, to the model you have open through the MCP server\, and delegate a task that involves multiple changes \- Decide what the agent may do\, for example edit the model's metadata without reading its data \- Follow the agent's changes as it works\, and revert all or only those changes you disagree with \- Let the …
